set.body: Child of the public Sherlock journey. Add SurfaceRendering.prepareTimed(recall, source: TimedSourceView), deriving every query and target from the complete checked source and recall. Preserve text-only behavior; use a distinct versioned timed rendering policy; retain actual checked source identity and no manufactured physical text support. Leaves render embedText or text; groups render embedText or label. Empty/invalid Unicode refuses. Outside-package tests prove full populations, target/ref binding, policy and differing payload identity. Parent owns pipeline caller and ADR. Exact commit review, mutation and scoped cross-platform gate plus consumer compatibility required.
set.title: Expose checked timed-source rendering to the ONNX registration path
